description: This file defines the PayPeriod entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'hs_hr_payperiod' database table using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for 'code' and 'name', with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: PayPeriod
classes.description: Entity class representing a pay period with code and optional name, mapped to the 'hs_hr_payperiod' table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the pay period, or null if not set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay period.
